description: The one weather state, per docs/adr/0015: it rains or it does not, in spans drawn from these ranges on the sim's own `weather` stream. dryTicks 144000..432000 is twelve to thirty-six in-game hours between spells, wetTicks 24000..72000 is two to six hours of rain -- roughly a spell every day or two, a first cut for the owner. Read by SimWeather only.
